verdict.rationale: Pinecone's docs describe a hosted Assistant feature that lets you create an AI assistant to answer grounded, cited questions over your proprietary data, which the llms.txt probe also lists as a product area. That is a built-in AI capability, but it is scoped to Q&A over uploaded data rather than a general assistant you hand product tasks to. The MCP server and Claude Code plugin rely on external agents, so they are not a built-in assistant and are not credited. Missing for 10: an in-product assistant that performs tasks such as index management or data operations from the console, documentation of delegation or agentic workflows beyond Q&A, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
